Strategy: Penalize mid-loose leftovers between forty-five and ninety, steering away from half-filled bins toward either tight fills or very loose bins. It may help by avoiding mediocre leftovers, but may fail by pushing placements into extremes that waste capacity.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) - (20 if r - item > 45 and r - item < 90 else 0) for r in bins]
```
